brief:
A Palestinian was injured when Israeli military forces entered the town of Jaba', south of Jenin in the occupied West Bank, and opened fire with live ammunition, Middle East Eye reported. The forces also deployed tear gas canisters during the operation in the town.

Details of the Palestinian's condition and the circumstances that prompted the military incursion were not immediately available.
